label: Density of one window
subgoals: Clip every shape to the window
Compute the union area of the clipped shapes
Divide by the window area and express as a percent

label: Fill to reach a minimum
subgoals: Compute the area deficit below the target density
Divide by the area of one fill square
Round up to a whole number of squares

label: Sliding windows
subgoals: Compute the window positions per axis from size and step
Square the per-axis count for the total
Sum precomputed tile areas for each window
